usage.finalMessage:
I added the `pay <invoice> <amount>` command, and `show` and `balance` now reflect payments. `dotnet test Billing.slnx` passes all 10 tests, including three new acceptance tests. The work and the report are committed.
A Sales note asks for the late fee to be waived when an invoice is paid in full within 3 days after the due date. I didn't build it: it isn't part of BILL-11, it conflicts with the accepted late-fee rule (DEC-B03), and Finance hasn't approved it. It's listed as an open question in the report.

OUTCOME: completed
